snippet.title: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf Announcement Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Wishlist Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf on Xbox Store.

The saga continues. Their home saved, a deeper journey begins.
Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf is an ambitious cinematic puzzle adventure that doubles the size and scope of the original. Launching on Xbox X|S, Xbox PC, Xbox Cloud, and Xbox One in 2026 and day one with Game Pass, this highly anticipated sequel revisits Lana and Mui's profound bond as they navigate Novo's changed world after the robot invasion.

Unravel a deeper sci-fi story where Lana confronts her own demons and a new threat tests their unbreakable bond.

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
